title: Bibliopolis library
description: The items of a collection: every item becomes one house. What a schema cannot say (an id used once, a topic that exists in the tree) the program checks; see docs/format.md.

id.description: Unique in the library; the id of the house.

year.description: The year of publication, or null.

doi.description: Optional; the program does not read it.

added_at.description: ISO 8601: a date, or a date and time with or without an offset (a time without one is read as UTC). Items arrive in this order, ties by id.

type.description: The kind of document, e.g. article, review, editorial, letter, news, erratum, retraction notice.

tags.description: Free tags: the residents of the house.

topics.description: Ids of nodes of the topic tree. The address of the house is the deepest of them (ties: the lower id). Empty: the house stands under the town hall.
